purpose.zh: 练髋部往里转的力量和控制
purpose.en: Build strength and control for turning your thigh inward.

text.zh: 膝盖不动，脚往外侧摆开
text.en: Keep your knee still and swing your foot out

text.zh: 坐直，大腿贴住椅面，双手放在大腿上。
text.en: Sit tall with your thigh on the seat and your hands on your thighs.

text.zh: 外面停一下，再慢慢收回。
text.en: Pause out there, then bring it back slowly.

commonErrors.zh: 膝盖跟着往里或往外跑
commonErrors.en: Letting the knee drift in or out.

cautions.zh: 固定点不牢时先别开始
cautions.en: Do not start until the anchor is secure.

cautions.zh: 髋或膝不舒服时摆小一点
cautions.en: If your hip or knee feels uncomfortable, swing a smaller distance.

changes: 名字去掉「髋内旋 / Internal Rotation」术语，按动画说成「脚向外摆」
口令按相位缩短（收回约 0.8 s）
flags: 改了动作名；tags.activeMuscles 写的是 abductors+glutes，动画实为大腿向内转（臀中/小肌），是否调整请定
